title: Traction Pulse: Pipeline Sprint - June 2026
content:
Purpose: sprintable snapshot to prime the CS weekly cadence and the June QBR. Focus = accounts with contracts expiring in the next 120 days and top ARR exposures. This is intentionally compact (one-tab) so AMs and Solutions E can triage fast.

Summary metrics (top-line):
- Snapshot date: 2026-06-20
- Accounts in view: 22 (this sheet = highest 10 by ARR exposure)
- Total ARR in view: $9,250,000
- ARR at immediate risk (P<=40%): $1,375,000
- Next major review: 2026-06-24 CS sprint (agenda item: exec engagement decisions)

Table: Renewal Tranche Quick Grid
Columns: Account | Contract End | ARR | Renewal Prob (%) | CS Owner | Last Touch | Next Step (week) | Risk Flags | Playbook Suggestion | Proposed Outreach Owner | Escalation Level | Notes

Rows:
1) Horizon Systems | 2026-09-01 | $2,800,000 | 55 | Marisol Vega | 2026-06-10 product ROI workshop | Exec business review + pricing cadence (wk 26) | Exec availability, QPS perf regression | Executive ROI + Dedicated capacity pilot | Marisol / Solutions | Partner ops / Sales Engineering | Customer has heavy peak usage; requested dedicated cap options; waiting for infra cost estimate (ENG-PRJ-881).

2) ClearPath Health | 2026-08-15 | $1,150,000 | 35 | Priya Sharma | 2026-06-02 renewal health check | Product migration plan + contract amendment (wk 25) | Budget freeze, security checklist incomplete | Security/compliance onboarding + discount ladder | Priya / Security AE | CS lead escalation | Waiting on SOC2 evidence (linked Confluence doc), finance requires PO by 2026-07-10.

3) Atlas Retail Group | 2026-10-03 | $1,000,000 | 70 | Liam O'Connor | 2026-06-18 usage review call | Standard renewal + success metrics recap (wk 27) | Churn risk low, interested in Optimize recommendations | Renewal w/ Optimize pilot upsell | Liam | no escalation | Good NPS; propose 6-month pilot for caching suggestions.

4) Meridian Telecom | 2026-08-01 | $900,000 | 25 | Daniel Park | 2026-06-05 outage postmortem | Price negotiations + penalty carveout (wk 26) | Performance SLA breach, legal reviewing | Escalated SLA remediation + partial credit | Daniel + Legal | Exec standby (VP CS) | SRE postmortem in-flight (SRE-672). Need decision on service credits.

5) NovaBank Digital | 2026-11-20 | $700,000 | 80 | Priya Sharma | 2026-06-16 platform roadmap | Long-term strategic, consider enterprise bundle (wk 28) | Regulatory extra docs requested | Private deployment evaluation + KMS option | Priya / Solutions | No escalation | Compliance questionnaire mostly completed; sales coordinating POC.

6) Ember Logistics | 2026-07-12 | $600,000 | 15 | Marisol Vega | 2026-05-30 trial ended | Immediate churn risk: finance pause (wk 25) | Procurement hold, executive disengaged | High-touch re-engage (exec+AE) + short-term discount | Marisol + AE | VP CS intervene | Suggested 2-week exec call; prepare 30/60/90 retention plan.

7) Orion Media | 2026-09-30 | $500,000 | 60 | Liam O'Connor | 2026-06-12 feature demo | Standard renewal outreach (wk 27) | Product fit minor gaps | Feature roadmap commit + credits | Liam | no escalation | Demo follow-up scheduled; propose advisory session.

8) GreenGrid Energy | 2026-08-20 | $380,000 | 40 | Daniel Park | 2026-06-01 pilot results | Negotiation on training + support (wk 26) | Budget reallocation | Training bundle + annual prepay discount | Daniel | Customer success manager (CSM) escalation | Training dates need locking by 2026-07-05.

9) Beacon EdTech | 2026-07-30 | $250,000 | 20 | Priya Sharma | 2026-06-07 adoption review | Urgent: low adoption, consider extension (wk 25) | Adoption < 30% | Adoption playbook + PO extension | Priya + CSM | Sales engagement | Offer free onboarding sprint to improve stickiness.

10) TerraManufacturing | 2026-10-10 | $290,000 | 45 | Marisol Vega | 2026-06-14 contract terms review | Renewal posture: neutral (wk 27) | Procurement slow | Standard renewal + case study ask | Marisol | no escalation | Ask for case study in return for extended terms.

Action summary (short):
- Owners to confirm exec outreach list by 2026-06-21 (focus: Horizon Systems, Ember Logistics, Meridian Telecom).
- Legal + Finance: Meridian service credit proposal due 2026-06-22.
- Security: ClearPath SOC2 evidence deadline with customer 2026-06-30.
- Product/Eng: capacity estimate for Horizon dedicated pilot due 2026-06-24 (ENG-PRJ-881).

Quick calculations (notes to AMs):
- ARR at P<=40% in this tab = Horizon ($2,800,000 at 55% excluded), ClearPath ($1,150,000 at 35%), Meridian ($900,000 at 25%), Ember ($600,000 at 15%), Beacon ($250,000 at 20%), GreenGrid ($380,000 at 40%) => conservative risk exposure approx $2.48M (sum of ARR weighted by (1 - probability)).

Playbook snippets (copyable):
- Exec Re-Engage Template: CEO/VP intro + 30-min business value brief + proposed pilot + 2-week technical deep-dive.
- Adoption Sprint Offer: 4-week onboarding with defined KPIs; success fee deferred to renewal.
- SLA Remediation Route: immediate mitigation plan, credit formula, timeline to restore SLOs; legal to approve at VP level.

Open questions / To dos (notes to self):
- Validate whether Horizon prefers term extension vs price reduction — Marisol to confirm during exec call.
- Should we propose a bundled Dedicated capacity discount for Horizon to lock 12 months? (ops impact — check infra runway).
- Ember: prepare one-pager retention economics for CFO conversation.
- Add a light-weight MRR-like column next sprint for monthly recognition.

Slack references: #cs-renewals, thread TS-2026-06-11; pull activity from playbook PR: github.com/redwood/cs-playbooks/pull/74

Version history (brief):
- 2026-06-12: initial export from CRM and manual cleanup (DP)
- 2026-06-15: added risk flags and playbook suggestions (MS)
- 2026-06-20: updated probabilities after adoption calls (PS, LO)

Status explanation: draft — intended to be the working single-source-of-truth for the June sprint; will distill into QBR slide pack if numbers hold.
